tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250ye shes rab 'bar las/ bdud mo khrag ral ma'i mdos kyi zin bris bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ he ru ka dpal padma'i sku la 'dud:

snyigs dus lha 'dre 'khrugs pas nad yams dar: de la phan pa'i khrag ral mdos kyi 'phyong: mdun bskyed bsgom pa ni: mdos yas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis byin brlabs nas: oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ sku gzugs mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las yi ge ma yongs su gyur pa las: bdud mo nag mo dud pa'am sol ba'i mdog can khrag gi ral pa dmar po thur du bshal ba: spyan gnyis nyi zla ltar bsgrad pas 'jig rten sreg pa: zhal gdangs pa las nad yams khrag gi kha phru 'thor ba: nga ro nam mkha'i mthongs su 'bod pa: nad sprin sngo dmar rlangs pas bar snang sgrib pa: mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs shing skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud pa: mig dang sna nas nad kyi dud sprin kham dmar 'khrigs pa: nu ma 'phyangs pa las khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa: thal mo gnyis bar snang khams su brdabs pas thal dud yul khams khengs pa: rked pa ri rab zom la brten pas sa nad me ltar 'bar ba: zhabs gnyis kyis rgya mtsho dkrugs pas dmu chu skya rbab bying chu 'thor ba: sku mdog nag mo gcer bu mi sdug pa'i 'gyings bag sgeg pa'i tshul du 'dug pa'o: de'i phyi rol du mon mo nag mo gcer bu bha ga rgyas pa: nu ma 'phyangs shing kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa: sdang mig bsgrad cing ral pa kham ser thur du bshal la gyen du sgreng ba: lag gnyis khram shing dang nad kyi rkyal pa thogs pa: zhabs gnyis phar 'gro ba'i tshul du 'dug pa: 'khor du nad yams kyi bdag mo: rims yams kyi bdag mo: sha za khrag 'thung dam sri za 'dre shi gshed gson 'dre yul 'dre rgya 'dre srin mo bdud mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam: zhes dang: bden pas bkug pa ni: na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka' bden pa dang: dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang: gu ru padma drag po rtsal ye shes rab 'bar gyi bden pa dang:

bde gshegs yongs 'dus sgrub chen dkyil 'khor dgu'i bden pa dang: rje 'bangs nyer lnga: klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i brgyud 'dzin dngos slob brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis: bdud mo khrag gi ral pa can: nad yams kyi bdag mo rgya 'dre srin mo'i rigs su gtogs pa thams cad skad cig gis 'dir khug cig: aṃ ku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ces rol mo dang bcas pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis bkug: sa ma ya: mdos spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas: mi rung chag chen tha dag zlogs: zhes yan chad: de nas glud lan chags bsngo ba ni: na maḥs manta bhuddha naṃ: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos nas: na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang: sogs nas: stong par gyur cig: gi yan chad kyis brgya rtsa brgyad bsngo bar bya'o: nad bdag mo'i glud bsngo ba ni: kye: rin chen ngar gyi mi mo 'di: zhes sogs nas: de bas 'gro la ma gnod cig: yan chad: de nas thog mar bdag nyid bskyed rim dang ldan pas: hrī: mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin gyi: sogs nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: yan chad brjod: de nas yul khams su nad yams thu bar byung na thun dang drag sngags kyis liṅga mdos bcas thun sngags rnams kyis gzhung ltar brab bo: de nas mdos phyir spags nas yaksha me dbal gyi lha 'dre'i tha tshig bsgrag: bskul ba bya: chad mdo 'don nas: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: sogs nas: de bas tshul 'di rtogs par gyis: sa ma ya ho: yan chad kyis mdos skyel: de nas gzhung gi brtan ma phul: gtor gzhong sbub nas rta bro brdung: bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam bya: sa ma ya: : gu hya: ༈ de nas khrag ral gyi mdos kyi 'phyong rdzas la: tha mar khrag sna rnyed tshad blugs pa'i khrag kong bcu drug: sgo nga la mtshal gyis bhyo zlog bris pa bcu drug: rdo dkar la nad yams zlog bris pa bcu drug:

khram shing la bhyo zlog bris pa bcu drug: mar me bcu drug: mda' bkra 'phang bkra bcu drug re: pho tang mo tang rgyang bu rnams bcu drug re: nam mkha' 'ja' khra bcu drug: rtsang mtshe yungs dkar sogs kyis brgyan: rgyas par brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor: gdugs nag po phub: ko gru'am 'khar gzhong du lug nag khrag gis bkang ba'i dbus su bzhag: 'og dur khrod kyi sa la maṇḍal gru bzhi zlum skor zur gsum bang rim gsum pa zla gam gyis mtshan pa bya: khrag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dbus su bsham mo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: : ces pa 'di ni lcags mdud slob ma chos nyid rang grol gyis zhus pa'i ngor klong gsal rdo rje snying pos smras pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// /
